messages:
Chen (Partnerships): FYI — ModelHub reached out about listing 'modelhub-7b-quant' on AWS/GCP marketplaces with Redwood as distributor. Need to check distro terms + announcement timing. Details: https://modelhub.example/asset/7b-quant :eyes:
Mike (PM): @Chen any LOI or proposed revenue share?
Chen (Partnerships): They sent a one-pager: 70/30 rev split, ModelHub retains IP, we handle billing & compliance. I'll paste key lines: 'ModelHub grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to distribute model weights and container images under ModelHub License v1.'
Oliver (Legal): Need to see full license. 'distribute weights' is risky — does it allow rehosting or only packaged images? Also export control & sanctions clause. Please DM me the license file. We usually require: attribution, no-endorsement clause, warranty disclaimer, audit rights for provenance, and a sub-licensing carveout.
Ana (DevRel): If we do a marketplace asset we need model card + inference cost estimate + Quickstart + sample prompts. Also prefer a joint blog + webinar. Any embargo dates with Vulcan (hardware) partner?
Sara (Eng): Packaging checklist (high level):
- signed sha256 for weights
- container image with runtime <= 8GB RAM footprint for the marketplace test harness
- quantized checkpoint (4-bit) + original float manifest
- example request/response + simple perf script
- eval harness (evals.tar.gz) + golden prompts
- provenance metadata (signed by ModelHub)
We must ensure compatibility with Redwood runtime-config v2.1. Example manifest snippet:
```
model: modelhub-7b-quant
format: hf-pt
quant: 4bit
provenance: sha256:abc123def456...
runtime: redwood-runtime:v2.1
```
Chen (Partnerships): ModelHub requested a public launch 2026-05-15 and wants to coordinate with Vulcan's board-level announcement the week before. Can we commit to joint press?
Oliver (Legal): 2026-05-15 is doable only if we get license + export checks + trademark clearance at least 2 weeks prior. We also need to confirm indemnity, liability caps, and a pause/recall mechanism for compliance flags. Can't promise Vulcan's earlier timeframe without accelerated approvals.
Mike (PM): @Ana @Sara what's the timeline to get asset + comms ready if license cleared by 2026-04-25?
Ana (DevRel): We can produce blog + Quickstart in ~7 business days once we have the packaged asset and access. Webinar needs ~3 weeks prep for slides + demo run.
Sara (Eng): Eng can package + run eval suite ~5 business days after we have weights + container access. We also need a Vulcan test account to run perf on their hardware (they want head-to-head numbers).
Chen (Partnerships): I'll ask ModelHub for a 2-week soft hold on public links and to provide the full license and weight signatures by 2026-04-22. Looping in Vulcan PM (cc @VulcanPM) for perf coordination.
marketplace-bot: Asset upload started: upload_id=ahf83k — initial static scan passed (no large-file heuristics triggered).
Mike (PM): Ops question — payout flow: do we invoice customers 100% and remit to ModelHub monthly, or do we net-settle? Need to capture in the commercial MOU.
Chen (Partnerships): ModelHub prefers platform handles payments and remits monthly net with CSV reporting + monthly reconciliation call.
Oliver (Legal): Make sure the settlement language includes tax-withholding responsibility, refund handling & customer chargebacks alignment, and a clear indemnity carveout for export/regulatory violations. Also require a mechanism to pause listing for active export compliance review.
Ana (DevRel): Quick comms note: if this goes public, we should lead with "Redwood partners with ModelHub to deliver optimized 7B quantized models on cloud marketplaces" and include Vulcan perf numbers if cleared. Webinar idea: joint demo + live Q&A; slot 45 minutes.
Mike (PM): Also need to confirm marketplace SKUs, entitlements, and monitoring hooks (usage, token counts) so billing aligns with the 70/30 split. Ops team will need mapping table.
Chen (Partnerships): I'm asking ModelHub for: full license text, signed weight hashes, Docker registry access (staging), Vulcan test creds, and a revenue ops contact.
Oliver (Legal): Once license arrives I'll do an initial review within 3 business days. If there are material distro restrictions we'll escalate to execs.
Ana (DevRel): Action items:
- Chen: collect license + signed hashes by 2026-04-22
- Oliver: license & export review within 3 business days of receipt
- Sara: packaging template + runtime compatibility doc by 2026-04-28
- Ana: draft joint announcement timeline + comms plan by 2026-04-29
- Mike: draft billing flow & revenue ops checklist (include SKU mapping)
We'll reconvene in this thread when license lands. :thumbsup:
Chen (Partnerships): Thanks all — pinging ModelHub now and will post the license here when it arrives.
